name: correction_20261010
target: y = measured / predicted - 1, decode ms per token; predicted as registered for the row's campaign

definitions.moe: 1 for a mixture of experts (a shape with active bytes per layer), else 0
definitions.kv_frac: KV bytes read per decoded token at the mean context depth / weight bytes read per decoded token; depth (N - 1) / 2 for llama-bench tg-N, P + (G - 1) / 2 for a served request; KV layers every block, or a qwen35 hybrid's full-attention blocks (one in 4)
definitions.pi_temp: max(0, T - 60) deg C, T the hottest Pi's peak in the row (1 Hz poll), else its end-of-cell STATE temperature; 0 with no Pi
definitions.visits: RPC worker stages per token (stages that are not the host's own process)

model: ordinary least squares, intercept + the five features; a feature constant over a fit's rows is left out of that fit; corrected = predicted x (1 + fitted y)

tests.statistic: mean over model families of the family's mean |measured / prediction - 1|, each family's rows corrected by the fit on every other family (leave one model family out)
reported_beside: the row-weighted mean |error|, corrected and uncorrected
both statistics without the qwen2.5-14b family (the figures for Documents/)
each family's mean |error| and the coefficients of every fit

tests.scored: prospectively, on the next 200 served requests after adoption
tests.interval: CV+ (10 folds by sha256(row id) mod 10): q = the ceil((n + 1) x 0.9)-th smallest out-of-fold |measured / corrected - 1|; interval [p_c (1 - q), p_c (1 + q)], p_c from the all-rows fit
tests.holds_when: 85 % <= the share of those requests whose mean server TPOT lies in its placement's interval <= 95 %
tests.reported_beside: adaptive conformal inference: alpha_1 = 0.10, alpha_t+1 = alpha_t + 0.005 (0.10 - miss_t)

adoption: only if CORR-LOFO holds: the all-rows correction as a default-off option; new registrations record the corrected prediction and its interval beside the analytic one. Plan choice by the 90th percentile is registered separately.
limits: predictor versions mix: two trips per worker before 2026-10-09, RTT1 after
tinyllama-1.1b is 67 of 118 rows, so the test weights families equally
qwen2.5-14b rows feed the analysis; Documents/ use the statistics without them
